Dear ImGui, vendored for the BLACK VR in-headset settings panel (port/quest/src/vr_panel_ui.cpp,
port/notes/settings-panel.md).

Source:   https://github.com/ocornut/imgui
Release:  v1.93.0 (tag), commit c1aaac65e896a45f81f47a4d68f9959e0f86c859, 2026-10-14
License:  MIT, LICENSE.txt (Copyright (c) 2014-2026 Omar Cornut)

Files copied unmodified: LICENSE.txt imconfig.h imgui.h imgui.cpp imgui_draw.cpp imgui_internal.h
imgui_tables.cpp imgui_widgets.cpp imstb_rectpack.h imstb_textedit.h imstb_truetype.h
(the stb_* headers are public domain / MIT, see their footers), and misc/fonts/Roboto-Medium.ttf.
No backends: the panel has its own Vulkan renderer. Build options are compile definitions in
port/quest/cmake/settings_panel.cmake (imconfig.h is untouched).

misc/fonts/Roboto-Medium.ttf: Roboto by Christian Robertson, Apache License 2.0
(https://fonts.google.com/specimen/Roboto, listed in imgui's docs/FONTS.md). It is embedded in
libblackvr.so as a byte array at build time (port/quest/cmake/bin2c.cmake).

To update: clone the new release tag, copy the same files over, rebuild tests/vr_glue and check
the panel screenshots (panel_*.png in its build directory).
